text:
alex: Heads up — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2310 needs landing before the Saturday deploy freeze at 2025-03-22 18:00 UTC. CI queue is backed up (~30m ETA) and it currently needs one approval and a green macOS e2e.

maria: @alex I can give the approval now if the failing test is flaky. Is there a failing test log? :mag:

alex: Test failing is `integration/embeddings_mac_test.py::test_long_sequences` — looks nondeterministic. Reproducer locally is flaky. Pushed a tiny fix in the last commit but CI hasn't re-run yet.

sam: I can kick a rerun on the mac lane. ci-bot, please rerun jobs for PR 2310. :pray:

ci-bot: ci-bot: Requested rerun for PR 2310. Position in queue: 18. Estimated start: ~28 minutes. If you need faster turnaround, consider rebase + force-push to bump priority or request an express slot from release-manager.

jordan: @release-manager can we get an express requeue for a hotfix candidate? We want to land before freeze if possible.

release-manager: We have two express slots left for today's freeze window. Please only use if this blocks a customer or causes regression. What's the risk if we defer to next window (Mon 2025-03-24)?

alex: Risk: customer-visible embedding mismatch for a pilot in prod; they've asked for this patch this week. If we defer, they'll delay rollout. I'd rather use one slot.

maria: I'm fine approving now. @alex can you rebase on main to bump CI priority and I'll approve after CI passes? :+1:

alex: Doing rebase + force-push now. Command: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease` — will paste new sha when done.

alex: (update) pushed new sha `c7f2a9b`. Asking for eyes — @maria @sam — CI is requeued.

ci-bot: ci-bot: PR 2310 requeued. New position: 3. Estimated start: 4 minutes.

sam: I'll watch the queue. If mac e2e flakes again, ping me and I'll run the integration locally and grab logs.

release-manager: Slot approved. Using one express slot now. If anything blocks we revert and reschedule. :lock:

alex: Thanks all — will merge after green. If anything unexpected, I’ll post an update here.

maria: Approved and standing by for green. Good luck! :rocket:
